'''Matthew Gountis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played Day 2 of the [[2009 World Championship]] and the [[2010 World Championship]]. ''Matthew Gauntley'' is a misreading of his handwritten name on his 2009 World Championship deck sheets.<ref>[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D2.pdf 2009 Worlds Day 2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org, pages 42–43. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008203132/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2009/Worlds/2009+Worlds+D2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref>[http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D2.pdf 2010 Worlds Day 2.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org, page 42. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008202452/http://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
